First, ask your advisor directly whether he backs the cross‑lab direction, whether funding covers the work, and whether he is comfortable with a real co‑advisor arrangement. If that is positive, speak with the single‑cell postdoc about what data access, authorship expectations, and PI approval would look like. Move forward only after you have a clear yes on data and funding. If the collaboration is solid, pursue the project; if not, fall back to the more standard tumor‑evolution path in your home lab. Set an internal checkpoint around 18 months: if you do not have a publishable result by then, pivot while you still have time.
